## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add aspect-ratio
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `AspectRatio.gx` | `ui/aspect-ratio/AspectRatio.gx` |
| `AspectRatio.fixtures.go` | `ui/aspect-ratio/AspectRatio.fixtures.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/aspect-ratio/AspectRatio.gx"
package aspectratio

props {
  Ratio    string   = "16 / 9"
  Class    string   = ""
  Children gx.Node
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil
}

<div style={gx.Style("aspect-ratio: " + p.Ratio)} class={gx.Cx("w-full overflow-hidden rounded-md", p.Class)} {...p.Attrs}>{p.Children}</div>
```

```go title="ui/aspect-ratio/AspectRatio.fixtures.go"
package aspectratio

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var AspectRatioFixtures = gx.Fixtures[AspectRatioProps]{
	"Wide":   {Ratio: "16 / 9", Children: gx.Text("16 / 9")},
	"Square": {Ratio: "1 / 1", Children: gx.Text("1 / 1")},
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

## Usage

```gx
<aspectratio.AspectRatio ratio="16 / 9">
  <img src={gx.URL("/hero.jpg")} alt="Hero" class="size-full object-cover" />
</aspectratio.AspectRatio>
```

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Set `Ratio` as a CSS ratio, for example `16 / 9`.
- Let the child fill the box with `size-full`.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not use an aspect ratio for text content.
- Do not nest aspect ratio boxes.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>
